notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier in NHANES, mapping to person_source_value to retain the original identifier.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored as an Observation with a custom concept for the weight type; value_as_number holds the weight value.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight. Stored similarly to WTDRD1 as an Observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the quality/completeness of the recall. Mapped to value_as_concept_id with a corresponding custom concept.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Stored as an Observation with the code in value_as_string, as there is no standard OMOP table for interviewer.
Breast-fed infant status (binary). Can be mapped to a Yes/No concept (e.g., 4188539 'Yes', 4188540 'No') in value_as_concept_id.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Stored as value_as_number in an Observation.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric value. Stored as value_as_number.
Intake day of the week is categorical. Can be mapped to standard day-of-week concepts or custom concepts in value_as_concept_id.
Language used mostly is categorical. Mapped to language concepts (e.g., English, Spanish) in value_as_concept_id.
Main respondent for this interview is categorical (e.g., self, proxy). Mapped to value_as_concept_id with appropriate concepts.
Helped in responding is categorical (e.g., yes/no or who helped). Mapped to value_as_concept_id.
Number of foods/beverages reported is a continuous count. Stored as value_as_number.
Salt used at table yesterday is binary (Yes/No). Mapped to standard Yes/No concepts in value_as_concept_id.
Type of salt used yesterday is categorical (e.g., ordinary, lite salt, sea salt). Mapped to value_as_concept_id with custom or standard concepts.
Energy intake in kcal. Maps to OMOP Measurement with concept for 'Energy' (kcal).
Protein intake in grams. Maps to 'Protein' measurement concept.
Carbohydrate intake in grams. Maps to 'Carbohydrate' measurement concept.
Total sugars intake in grams. Maps to 'Sugars, total' measurement concept.
Dietary fiber intake in grams. Maps to 'Fiber, total dietary' measurement concept.
Total fat intake in grams. Maps to 'Fat, total' measurement concept.
Saturated fatty acids intake in grams. Maps to 'Fatty acids, total saturated' measurement concept.
Monounsaturated fatty acids intake in grams. Maps to 'Fatty acids, total monounsaturated' measurement concept.
Polyunsaturated fatty acids intake in grams. Maps to 'Fatty acids, total polyunsaturated' measurement concept.
Cholesterol intake in mg. Maps to 'Cholesterol' measurement concept.
Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) intake in mg. Maps to 'Vitamin E' measurement concept.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) in mg. No direct standard concept; may use same Vitamin E concept with 'added' qualifier or custom concept.
Retinol intake in mcg. Maps to 'Retinol' measurement concept.
Vitamin A, RAE intake in mcg. Maps to 'Vitamin A' measurement concept.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. No standard OMOP concept; may require custom mapping or use 'Carotene' concept.
Beta-carotene intake measured in mcg. Maps to Measurement concept for Beta-carotene.
Beta-cryptoxanthin intake measured in mcg. Maps to Measurement concept for Beta-cryptoxanthin.
Lycopene intake measured in mcg. Maps to Measurement concept for Lycopene.
Lutein + zeaxanthin intake measured in mcg. Maps to Measurement concept for Lutein and Zeaxanthin.
Thiamin (Vitamin B1) intake measured in mg. Maps to Measurement concept for Thiamin.
Riboflavin (Vitamin B2) intake measured in mg. Maps to Measurement concept for Riboflavin.
Niacin intake measured in mg. Maps to Measurement concept for Niacin.
Vitamin B6 intake measured in mg. Maps to Measurement concept for Vitamin B6.
Total folate intake measured in mcg. Maps to Measurement concept for Folate.
Folic acid intake measured in mcg. Maps to Folate concept as a specific form; use value_as_concept_id or modifier for distinction if needed.
Food folate intake measured in mcg. Maps to Folate concept; source of folate (food) can be recorded in measurement_source_value.
Folate, DFE (dietary folate equivalents) measured in mcg. Maps to Folate concept; DFE is a calculation method, captured in measurement_source_value.
Total choline intake measured in mg. Maps to Measurement concept for Choline.
Vitamin B12 intake measured in mcg. Maps to Measurement concept for Vitamin B12.
Added vitamin B12 intake measured in mcg. Maps to Vitamin B12 concept; 'added' source can be recorded in measurement_source_value.
Vitamin C intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004501 = Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C).
Vitamin D (D2+D3) intake in mcg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004502 = Vitamin D.
Vitamin K intake in mcg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004503 = Vitamin K.
Calcium intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004504 = Calcium.
Phosphorus intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004505 = Phosphorus.
Magnesium intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004506 = Magnesium.
Iron intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004507 = Iron.
Zinc intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004508 = Zinc.
Copper intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004509 = Copper.
Sodium intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004510 = Sodium.
Potassium intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004511 = Potassium.
Selenium intake in mcg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004512 = Selenium.
Caffeine intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004513 = Caffeine.
Theobromine intake in mg; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004514 = Theobromine.
Alcohol intake in gm; maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3004515 = Alcohol.
Moisture content in grams; maps to measurement table as a numeric value. No standard concept for total moisture; use a custom concept or null.
Saturated fatty acid 4:0 (butanoic) intake in grams. No standard OMOP concept for individual fatty acid intake; store as numeric measurement.
SFA 6:0 (hexanoic) intake in grams. No standard concept; numeric measurement.
SFA 8:0 (octanoic) intake in grams. No standard concept; numeric measurement.

MFA 20:1 (eicosenoic) intake in grams. No standard concept; numeric measurement.

Nutrient intake measurement. Map to measurement table with measurement_concept_id for PFA 20:4 intake. Value stored as number (grams).
Nutrient intake measurement. Map to measurement table with measurement_concept_id for PFA 20:5 intake. Value stored as number (grams).
Nutrient intake measurement. Map to measurement table with measurement_concept_id for PFA 22:5 intake. Value stored as number (grams).
Nutrient intake measurement. Map to measurement table with measurement_concept_id for PFA 22:6 intake. Value stored as number (grams).
Categorical question about food consumption comparison. Map to observation table with observation_concept_id for 'Comparison of food consumed to usual'. Value stored as concept_id for response.
